tagline: Index and mapping exploration with query-DSL search — scoped API keys strongly recommended.
requirements: Set ES_URL in the host environment plus either ES_API_KEY or both ES_USERNAME and ES_PASSWORD. Use a dedicated API key with read-only privileges on the indices you intend to share. This is the official experimental server from Elastic.

tools.name: list_indices
tools.note: Lists indices the credentials can see.

tools.name: get_mappings
tools.note: Reads field mappings for an index.

tools.name: search
tools.note: Runs query-DSL searches and returns document contents from permitted indices — scope the API key to data that can be shared.

seo.description: Share the official Elasticsearch MCP server with MCPWire. Configure a scoped API key on the host, let teammates search indices and mappings over P2P, and keep the session read-only.
